reason_catalog.candidate-eligible: Complete read-clean unit carries an explicit explanation or implicit declaration/state/assertion contract; private/internal/test and large/code-only units retain eligibility.
reason_catalog.provisionally-excluded-pending-edit-over: Completed pending-review editor patch overlaps this original unit; restore/reselect if final patch drops or moves the change.
reason_catalog.excluded-administrative-preamble: Exact unit contains only imports/namespace/license/structural context; no declaration, XML or substantive explanatory claim.
reason_catalog.excluded-accepted-edited-overlap: Actual removed/replaced original line span or attached insertion boundary overlaps accepted integrated documentation patch.
reason_catalog.excluded-derived-rendering: Raw/diagram artifact, not eligible clean prose; source diagram/map claims retain separate units.
reason_catalog.excluded-API-support: Analyzer/synthesized/declaration snapshot is support rather than prose-clean or compiler binding.
reason_catalog.excluded-historical: Inventory classifies historical/dormant material; preserve provenance without clean-current-contract credit.
reason_catalog.excluded-original-disposition: Exact original_status supplies the exclusion: candidate, related context, historical, qualified or explicit exclusion. Original hash-bound ledger retains its detailed reason; none receives clean sampling credit.
